title: GEMglIsEnabled
description: test whether a capability is enabled

messages.description: symbolic constant indicating a GL capability
1 if the capability is enabled, 0 if not

arguments.description: symbolic constant indicating a GL capability

body: [GEMglIsEnabled] calls glIsEnabled() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glIsEnabled in the OpenGL reference.
